### Work Breakdown Structure
- Backend Development
  - Design database schema for reviews and moderation status (2 person days)
  - Implement API endpoints for submitting, retrieving, and moderating reviews (4 person days)
  - Add support for photo uploads and storage (3 person days)
  - Calculate and expose average rating per product (2 person days)
- Frontend Development
  - Add review submission UI with star rating, text, and photo upload (4 person days)
  - Display reviews on product pages, including photos and average rating (3 person days)
  - Build moderation interface for admin users (3 person days)
- Moderation Workflow
  - Implement moderation queue and review approval/rejection logic (2 person days)
  - Notification system for moderators (email or dashboard alerts) (2 person days)
- Testing & QA
  - Unit and integration tests for backend and frontend (3 person days)
  - User acceptance testing and bug fixes (2 person days)
- Deployment & Documentation
  - Update deployment scripts and environment configs (1 person day)
  - Write user/admin documentation for new features (1 person day)

### Total Estimate
37 person days

### Assumptions
- Existing e-commerce platform supports user authentication and product catalog.
- Photo uploads are limited to standard image formats and reasonable file sizes.
- Moderation will be handled by internal staff via a web interface.
- No advanced moderation features (e.g., AI, bulk actions) are required.
- The team is familiar with the current tech stack and codebase.
- No major changes to mobile apps are required; only web platform is in scope.
- Holiday season deadline allows for 6+ weeks of development time.
